nodes.label: EyeshadowBlendModeFix
nodes.description: renderEyeshadow lid/crease/outer-V changed from multiply to source-over. multiply is invisible on non-white skin; source-over with alpha 0.28-0.40 renders correctly.

nodes.label: isStripeVisibleThresholdFix
nodes.description: isStripeVisible default threshold 0.08 gates out eyelid landmarks on static photos with slight face pitch. Raised to 0.15 for EYESHADOW_L/R_LID and EYELINER_L/R. The 0.08 value is correct for live camera head-turn rejection only.
